title: inspect_wire's InspectRefused reaches the diagnostic mixin
intention: inspect_wire's InspectRefused reaches DiagnosticBase, so every class with code in inspect_wire can run a diagnostic report and the mixin sieve stands clear there.
why: Measured 2026-11-16 by a full build_inspector inspect over the house tree: every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin stands above baseline at one component, tools/inspect_wire — 'cairn/tools/inspect_wire/inspect_wire.py:96 class InspectRefused has code and does not reach DiagnosticBase' (reason 'no route'), live as the trouble inspector-new-finding-every-class-reaches-the-diagnostic-mixin. 3e08102ef35a (080caf937) added the class as a plain RuntimeError.
traces_to: Law 9 and Akien's ruling open-4141d959b634: every class with code inherits the diagnostic mixin; every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin is its physics.
how: class InspectRefused(DiagnosticBase, RuntimeError), with DiagnosticBase imported from cairn.tools.base.diagnostic at top level (the AmbiguousComponent pattern). A red-first proof asks the sieve over the bus for cairn/tools/inspect_wire and holds the exception's behaviour.

clauses.claim: build_inspector's every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin, asked over the bus, returns no finding for cairn/tools/inspect_wire

InspectRefused is a DiagnosticBase and still a RuntimeError, with its message, args, judge, reason and raised unchanged, caught by except RuntimeError; inspect_wire.py's top-level imports are stdlib plus cairn.tools.base.diagnostic only

decisions.text: D1: InspectRefused takes DiagnosticBase as its first base; inspect_wire.py imports DiagnosticBase from cairn.tools.base.diagnostic at top level.
D2: the red-first proof copies the shape of bus_client's mixin proof; one tooth per clause.

out: cairn/machines/build_inspector (the sieve is read, not changed)

measured.how: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c 'from cairn.machines.build_inspector import inspector as I; I.inspect()' over the house tree, read-only

measured.saw: the new proof red on the base, both teeth: the sieve names inspect_wire.py:96, and InspectRefused is not a DiagnosticBase
measured.how: bin/cairn test --exec over the proof in the inspect-refused-reaches-the-mixin worktree
